title: Sher E Hindustan - Warrior
desc: After working at a house as a servant, a young woman, along with her grandmother, sets off to avenge the death of her sister and father after an astrologer predicts that she is an avatar of God.

title: Hit List
desc: Vijay's life turns into a living hell when a mysterious masked figure kidnaps his family.

title: Jawaan
desc: Yellapragada Jai, an honest man, faces challenges when his childhood friend, Keshava, becomes a criminal. To protect his country, Jai puts everything on the line to thwart Keshava's perilous plans.

title: Saamy 2
desc: Ramaswamy, who works as a front-end receptionist for Union Minister Viswanathan, decides to pursue civil service. Soon, Viswanathan's daughter falls in love with him after he saves her from gangsters.

title: Spyder
desc: Shiva, an intelligence officer, develops a phone software that helps him track those in need of help. He sets out to save the people of Hyderabad when he realises that a serial killer is on the loose.
